label: Calls offered
definition: Calls that reached the site's queue for the line that day, answered or not.
first_check: Is something outside driving calls (weather, a mailing, an outage on the website)? Move staff from a quieter line if it lasts.

label: Service level
definition: Share of offered calls answered within 60 seconds; a call that hangs up counts against it.
first_check: Staffed hours against plan for the day, then handle time: one of the two has usually moved.

label: Abandon rate
definition: Share of offered calls where the caller hung up before an agent answered.
first_check: Staffed hours against plan, then handle time, as for service level; callers who hang up often call back, so expect more calls tomorrow.

label: Average handle time
definition: Talk, hold and after-call work per answered call.
first_check: A new step, script or system change on that line, or new staff still learning. A slow rise is easy to miss day to day.

label: New claims
definition: Claims opened at the site for the line that day.
formula: count of claims with opened_date = day
first_check: A weather event or a catastrophe code; tell the adjusters' team leads before the backlog builds.

label: Claims closed
definition: Claims closed at the site for the line that day.
formula: count of claims with closed_date = day
first_check: Adjusters off or moved to other work; a system that blocked closing.

label: Open claims
definition: Claims opened on or before the day and still open at its end.
formula: opened by the day minus closed by the day
first_check: New claims against closing capacity; borrow adjusters or approve overtime while it is still growing.
